verdict.rationale: Mollie documents a broad API surface covering the main merchant operations: payments, payment links, subscriptions and recurring payments, refunds (available through both the API and the Web app), chargebacks, balances, settlements, Connect splits and fees, and webhooks with an events audit API. An MCP server also proxies many of these APIs. However, nothing in the pack claims or shows API–UI parity, chargebacks appear to be retrieve-only, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404 at every candidate path. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, evidence of API coverage for dashboard-only tasks (account and profile settings, onboarding management, report generation), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.
